messages:
maya: quick heads-up — ran AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 bakeoff on tablex-extract v2. saw a noticeable hallucination spike with AWQ-int8 on rows containing nested markdown/escaped newlines. dumping short notes and a failing sample below.

jason: can you paste the exact experiment config and seed? which model variant & quant pipeline?

maya: setup: model=hf/redwood-demo-13b, variants=[fp8, gptq-4bit, awq-int8], seq_len=1024, batch=8, seed=42. AWQ used default per-tensor calibration (awq-1.2). command: 
```
python eval.py --model redwood-demo-13b --quant awq --bits 8 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --seed 42 --task tablex
```

metrics-bot: summary: AWQ-INT8 F1(tablex)=0.68 (-0.12 vs FP8), hallucination_rate=0.28 (+0.08) 

sara: can you paste a failing input + outputs (gold vs awq)?

maya: failing sample:
INPUT:
```
| id | details |
|----|---------|
| 4  | "Steps:\n1. install\n2. configure" |
```
GOLD: {"id": "4", "details": "Steps:\n1. install\n2. configure"}
AWQ-OUT: {"id": "4", "details": "1) install 2) configure. Note: also run setup.sh"}
GPTQ-OUT: {"id": "4", "details": "Steps:\n1. install\n2. configure"}
FP8-OUT: same as gold

liam: looks like AWQ inserts an extra short paraphrase — maybe decoding/EOS handling or a subtle tokenization shift. Were decoding params identical across runs?

maya: yes, decoding params same: top_p=0.95, temp=0.0, max_new_tokens=256. config snippet:
```
decode: {"do_sample": false, "top_p": 0.95, "temperature": 0.0}
```

priyanka: hypothesis: tokenization + quantization shift causing token alignment differences or KV cache boundary effects on nested newlines. Try running AWQ with force_cpu_tokenizer and batch=1 to remove batching effects.

jason: reran AWQ with --batch 1 and --force_cpu_tokenizer, that specific sample now matches gold, but aggregate still shows ~6% F1 gap. attached run id run-2003-awq-01.

metrics-bot: updated: AWQ-INT8 (batch=1) F1=0.75 (-0.05 vs FP8).

sara: good repro. can we bisect further? try flipping kv-management flags: --kv-evict-threshold and --kv-stride.

maya: will run kv-evict-threshold=0.6 vs default 0.8 and also test awq-1.3 calibration.

deploy-bot: note: a canary using awq-int8 was rolled to staging at 2003456700 for smoke tests — rollout paused.

priyanka: action items: (1) maya run kv-flag + calibration sweep, (2) liam add tokenizer/token-diff checks to eval harness, (3) jason collect per-sample token diffs & attach to run-2003-awq-01. target: decide rollback vs tuning by EOD.

maya: ack, starting runs now. will post results + run ids.

jason: ping if you want me to repro locally; I can spare a node.

maya: thanks — will ping if needed.
